order: Re-open the WO-11 quartermaster review for a second round. Re-anchor every recorded Amber-arm confirmation so analyze() checks it against live evidence at each call — evidence timestamp match, live predicate, no fresh throttle, no exhausted bucket, no malformed-latest reading — instead of trusting any confirmation that falls inside the freshness window. Make confirm() refuse outright, appending nothing, when the bucket is freshly throttled, exhausted, or its latest raw line is malformed. Add strict validation to every public entry point so caller-supplied forecast, maxFreshMs, and maxStaleMs are rejected unless they are finite numbers — do not let string inputs silently coerce. Re-rule finding D1 in full against the reviewer's verbatim round-2 text, keeping the round-1 text struck through rather than deleted, and restore F-1's dropped substance as its own line. Correct the status summary's quick-start line and the incident-2 record to match the actual exercise outcomes, and reconcile the remaining count and attribution nits across the band record and role docs.
claims: We added 33 checks across four new adversarial sections, bringing the suite from 154 to 187, verified them failing against the pre-fix implementation — 29 failures, including the critical exploit dispatching instead of gating and a live range error out of predictThrottle — then verified all green after the fix. D1 was re-ruled against the reviewer's verbatim text, the incident-2 record reconciled against its sibling report, and count and attribution nits across the band record and role docs were resolved.
